Notation contract

축 순서를 먼저 고정합니다

같은 tensor라도 단계와 kernel에 따라 physical layout이 다를 수 있습니다. 아래 표기는 이 교재의 기본 논리 convention이며, 다른 layout을 쓰면 그 자리에서 명시합니다.

[B,T,d]Residual stream

Batch, token sequence, model width.

[B,T,H,D]Head split 직후

Projection을 reshape한 상태. d=H×D.

[B,H,T,D]Attention 계산

T와 H를 transpose한 이 교재의 기본 attention layout.

[B,H,Tq,Tk]Attention scores

Q @ K.transpose(-2,-1)의 결과. D만 contraction됩니다.

중요: 이것은 universal physical layout이 아닙니다. FlashAttention, paged KV kernels, framework별 SDPA는 다른 stride나 축 배치를 사용할 수 있습니다. 수식의 logical axes와 실제 storage layout을 구분해야 합니다.

Research track
Turn implementation into a paper

          
A paper begins with a measurable contradiction, not with a system name.

        

        

          
01 · Observe
Find an anomaly
Locate a regime where a standard policy fails: long-context prefill interference, block waste, tail-latency collapse, or unfairness across request classes.

          
02 · Hypothesize
Name the mechanism
State the causal mechanism and a falsifiable prediction. Specify what result would prove you wrong.

          
03 · Compare
Build honest baselines
Hold model, hardware, workload, precision, and quality constant. Compare against the strongest relevant scheduler or cache policy.

          
04 · Ablate
Isolate the contribution
Remove each mechanism independently. Report median and tail latency, throughput, memory utilization, and quality impact.

        

        

          

            
Claim template

            
Under workload W, existing policy P causes measured failure F because of mechanism M. Our method X changes M and improves metric Y by Δ without degrading constraint Z.

          

          
    
            
  • Workload: arrival process, prompt/output distributions, SLO classes
    • 
            
  • Metrics: TTFT, TPOT, p50/p95/p99 latency, goodput, memory waste
    • 
            
  • Controls: model, GPU, parallelism, precision, sampling, warm-up
    • 
            
  • Evidence: profiler traces, sensitivity analysis, confidence intervals
